user.title: Connect to BetaSeries
user.description: Choose how to authenticate with BetaSeries.

device_credentials.title: Connect to BetaSeries
device_credentials.description: Enter the API key and client secret from your personal BetaSeries API application (create one at {betaserie_api_url}).

data_description.locale: Language BetaSeries responses (genres, descriptions, error messages) are returned in. Changeable later in the integration's options. Note: BetaSeries currently ignores this setting and replies in your BetaSeries account's own language, so changing it may have no visible effect.

device_credentials_error.title: Could not connect
device_credentials_error.description: Something went wrong while authenticating with BetaSeries. Try again, or choose a different authentication method.

password_credentials.title: Connect to BetaSeries
password_credentials.description: Enter the API key from your personal BetaSeries API application (create one at {betaserie_api_url}), and your BetaSeries account login and password. Warning: unlike the device code, this returns a token BetaSeries never revokes - not even if you later change your account password.

data_description.locale: Language BetaSeries responses (genres, descriptions, error messages) are returned in. Changeable later in the integration's options. Note: BetaSeries currently ignores this setting and replies in your BetaSeries account's own language, so changing it may have no visible effect.

password_credentials_error.title: Could not connect
password_credentials_error.description: Something went wrong while authenticating with BetaSeries. Try again, or choose a different authentication method.

timeout.title: Authentication timed out
timeout.description: The device code expired before it was validated on the BetaSeries website. Press Submit to try again.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate with BetaSeries
reauth_confirm.description: Your BetaSeries authentication needs to be renewed. Press Submit to start the authentication process again.
